Specifies whether to return all detection points. Valid values:

- false (default): Returns the detection points that are available to you.

- true: Returns all detection points.

title.zh: 查询拨测探测节点列表

descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，查询运营商“联通”在“北京市”的探测点详情。
descriptions.en: This topic provides an example of how to call the DescribeSyntheticProbeList operation to query detection point details for the China Unicom carrier in Beijing.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms describe-synthetic-probe-list --isp China_Unicom --city Beijing --ipv4 false --ipv6 false --view-all true --mb-probe false --lm-probe false --idc-probe false --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms DescribeSyntheticProbeList --region cn-hangzhou --Ipv6 false --Isp China_Unicom --Ipv4 false --ViewAll true --LmProbe false --IdcProbe false --City Beijing --MbProbe false
